content.short: Chibi Clash is a play-to-earn blockchain game featuring staking, recruiting and a multiplayer auto battler.
content.description: Chibi Clash delivers a PvP battle experience on Web3, blending accessible auto battler gameplay with a distinctive 2D universe inspired by Romance of the Three Kingdoms and Journey to the West. The game weaves staking and recruiting into its play-to-earn ecosystem, adding strategic depth to matches and character progression. It runs on Polygon, Ethereum, Solana and Arbitrum, enabling cross-chain competition and a decentralized, player-driven arena for competitive play.
